# Random Sites On the Web

> A hand-made collection of 194 tiny, single-purpose interactive websites: games, toys, art, tools, and small experiments. Free to use, no accounts. Made by Dylan Landman.

- [Homepage and full catalog](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/): browse every site, or press "Surprise Me!" to open a random one
- [About](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/about/): what the site is and who makes it
- [Privacy policy](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/privacy/): ads, analytics, and cookies

## Educational

- [Binary Ticker](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/binaryticker/): An odometer counting in decimal, binary, octal and hex — the bits are yours to flip
- [Chaos Game](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/chaosgame/): Place three dots and watch pure randomness draw a perfect fractal
- [Coastline](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/coastline/): How long is the coast? Depends how hard you look.
- [CSS Test](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/csstest/): Test and experiment with different CSS styles and effects
- [Cymatics](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/cymatics/): Sand on a vibrating plate always finds the same lines. Change the note and watch it decide again.
- [Digits of Now](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/digitsofnow/): The number of seconds since January 1st, 1970, ticking live — with a running note on whatever happens to be true about it.
- [How High Can You Hear?](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/hearingtest/): A tone climbs until it vanishes. Find out how old your ears are.
- [LocalStorage Terminal](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/localstorage-terminal/): A terminal emulator that uses localStorage as a virtual filesystem
- [Morse Code Sandbox](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/morse-code/): Learn and Practice Morse Code!
- [Pi Digit Distribution](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/pi/): A census of the first million digits of π — sweep the count and watch the digits jockey
- [Project Idea Slot Machine](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/slot-machine/): Spin the wheels of creativity to generate random project ideas
- [Roman Numeral Converter](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/roman-numerals/): Numerals chiseled onto a slab, itemized on the mason's invoice — converts both directions
- [The Cursor Petting Zoo](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/cursors/): Every CSS cursor in its own enclosure — pet them, adopt your favorite
- [The Möbius Strip](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/mobiusstrip/): A little car drives an endless lap around a Möbius strip and comes back upside-down every time. Drag to look at it from anywhere.
- [The Polygon March](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/polygonmarch/): Triangle, square, pentagon, hexagon... it just keeps going. Eventually it becomes a circle. It was never a circle.
- [The Punctuation Cemetery](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/punctuation-cemetery/): Retired punctuation marks, laid to rest with full honors. Pay your respects to the exclamation comma.
- [Wikipedia Roulette](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/wikipedia-roulette/): One button. One real random Wikipedia article, opened in a new tab. That's the whole site.

## Fun & Interactive

- [2,500 Balls](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/thousandballs/): Exactly two thousand five hundred bouncing balls. Count them if you don't believe us.
- [Bread](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/bread/): A random photo of bread. That's it. Click for another.
- [Bubble Wrap](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/bubblewrap/): An infinite sheet of bubble wrap. You know what to do.
- [Camouflage](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/camouflage/): A white page with white text. It's in there somewhere.
- [Can't Touch Me](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/canttouchme/): A button you cannot press. Go ahead, try.
- [ChatGPT With An Attitude](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/chatgptwithanattitude/): Chat with a sassy AI assistant
- [Checkbox Grid](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/checkboxgrid/): Interactive grid of checkboxes
- [Clicker Pen](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/clickerpen/): A retractable pen that clicks perfectly, forever. The counter never forgets. The warranty is void.
- [Comic Move Attacks](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/comicmoves/): Click anywhere to unleash epic comic book action effects!
- [Cool (and Uncool) Loaders](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/coolloaders/): 48 loading animations, loading nothing. Stamp each one COOL or UNCOOL — someone has to.
- [Cube Loader](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/cubeloader/): An infinite boot animation. Roll the cube in any direction, forever. The console never arrives.
- [Dead Weight](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/deadweight/): Your cursor gained weight. It lags, sags, and falls when you stop moving — and the magnets you plant yank it right off course.
- [Don't Press The Button](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/dontpressthebutton/): A button, a form on file, and a department that keeps minutes. Do not press it.
- [Duplicate](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/duplicate/): Watch text exponentially duplicate from 1 'a' to infinity
- [Etch A Sketch](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/etchasketch/): Twist the knobs to drag one unbroken line across the silver screen — then shake it clean. Diagonals are a two-handed negotiation.
- [Every Day Is A Holiday](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/every-day-is-a-holiday/): A curated year-long calendar of real, mostly-invented novelty holidays — browse the whole year, or jump straight to today.
- [Eye Chart](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/eyechart/): A perfectly normal vision test — until the rows you squint at stop being letters and start being about you.
- [Eyes on Me](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/eyesonme/): Use your imagination on this one!
- [Falling Keys](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/fallingkeys/): Type and the keys fall off an invisible keyboard, bounce, and pile up
- [Googly Eyes](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/googlyeyes/): A wall of googly eyes. They follow your cursor, droop when you stop, and rattle when you knock.
- [Grass](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/grass/): A dense field of thin blades that lean away from your cursor like wind pushing through them, then spring back with a little overshoot.
- [Happy Birthday!](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/happybirthday/): Create personalized birthday celebrations with effects
- [Hello](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/hello/): It says hello. Click and it says hello in another language — then another, and another, from all over the world.
- [Hyperspace](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/hyperspace/): Drift through the stars, or hold anywhere to punch it — the stars streak, the odometer climbs, physics is notified. Destination: none.
- [Infinite Maze](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/infinitemaze/): Zoom out. The maze keeps going. Zoom out more.
- [Infinite Number Casino](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/infinitenumbercasino/): Every number, one at a time. Some are worth something. The house keeps your tab.
- [Invent-A-Day](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/inventaday/): Pick two days of the week. Push them into each other. Keep whatever survives the collision.
- [Laser Maze](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/lasermaze/): Aim a laser pinned to the center of a shape and watch it bounce off the walls forever.
- [Linguistic Anomalies](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/linguisticanomolies/): Sentences that are grammatically correct, but shouldn't be.
- [Lucky Chest](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/luckychest/): Tap the chest. Sometimes it upgrades. Paperclips, a good stick, the other sock — collect them all in your binder.
- [Magic 8 Ball](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/magic8ball/): Ask the mystical 8 ball your questions
- [Mirror](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/mirror/): Type something and watch it appear in 4 versions: normal, backwards, upside-down, and mirrored — all at once
- [Name a Shape](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/nameashape/): A shape appears under the spotlight. Name it. Take its portrait.
- [Nice Cursor](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/nicecursor/): A cursor so big it shoves the whole page around
- [On This Day](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/on-this-day/): Pick your birthday and get a full real timeline of notable events, births, and deaths that happened on that calendar day.
- [Password Security Checker](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/passwordSecurity/): Type a password and get judged: crack-time estimates, itemized violations, and a lock that beefs up as you improve. Nothing leaves the page.
- [Pinwheel Field](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/pinwheelfield/): A grid of tiny windmills. Each one's spin speed depends on how close and how fast your cursor swept past it recently — wave your mouse and you get a trailing gust of spinning pinwheels.
- [Psychedelic Waves](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/psychadelics/): Paint into a living chemical culture and watch it bloom, crawl, and divide
- [Pull the Cord](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/pullthecord/): A bulb, a cord, a room. Yank the cord — it clicks, springs back, and the lights go out everywhere.
- [QR Wall](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/qr-wall/): An infinite wall of QR codes. Drag to wander, tap any one, and it takes you somewhere real.
- [Rube Goldberg Machine](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/rubegoldberg/): Click START and watch a 10-step chain reaction of satisfying canvas animations
- [Scrollympics](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/scrollympics/): Your scrolling career, measured in real distances. Medals included.
- [Sisyphus](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/sisyphus/): Scroll to push the boulder up a mountain that never ends. Stop, and it all comes back down.
- [Spend the National Debt](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/nationaldebt/): You've been handed the entire US national debt. Spend it on jets, islands, and aircraft carriers — the clock keeps ticking up faster than you can.
- [Spend Your Life](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/spendyourlife/): Your budget isn't money — it's the hours you have left. Spend them on sleep, meetings, guitar, and falling in love, and watch the clock drain.
- [The Dummy Factory](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/dummyfactory/): A bear-headed helicopter in clown shoes. Or reroll for one of 29,000 others.
- [The Largest Triangle](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/largesttriangle/): A triangle. It has a point. Keep scrolling.
- [The Longest Name](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/prefixsuffix/): Hello, my name is... build the longest, most decorated name in history, one title at a time
- [The Quietest Site on the Web](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/quietest/): 0.000 dB and holding. Please do not adjust your volume.
- [The Stress Dummy](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/stressdummy/): A floppy little ragdoll who exists to be flung, dragged, and bopped around the screen. Grab it, throw it, whack it. It always bounces back.
- [Visit Counter](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/visitcounter/): An official odometer of your visits. Unique visitors: 1. The button trusts you.
- [Welcome Back](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/welcomeback/): Your visitor time card: it knows exactly how long you were gone, and it keeps records.
- [Wet Paint](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/wetpaint/): The sign says do not touch. Everything you touch smears.
- [Write Me a Story](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/writemeastory/): Interactive story writing experience
- [You Are Being Watched](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/youarebeingwatched/): A fake surveillance feed of you — with tracking boxes, biometric readouts, and a rising threat level.

## Tools

- [5 O'Clock Somewhere](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/5oclock/): It is always, provably, 5 o'clock somewhere. Here's exactly where.
- [About My Device](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/metadata/): Your device's annual inspection: examined line by line, remarks included, verdict stamped.
- [ASCII Cam](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/asciicam/): Your camera, rendered live as colored ASCII. Nothing leaves the page.
- [ASCII Key Tester](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/asciikeyboard/): Press any key — its character code gets inspected and the keycap joins the pile
- [Character Counter](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/charactercounter/): Paste anything. The bureau counts it, files a report, and bills someone else's time.
- [Flag Maker](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/flag-maker/): Remix a real flag or build one from scratch — stripes, a canton, a field of stars, any colors you want. Download it or send someone the link.
- [Fontsmith](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/fontsmith/): Draw every letter, number, and punctuation mark by hand, then download a real, installable font you made yourself. Or upload one and see how it types.
- [Fractal](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/fractal/): Click to split the screen in half, forever. Or shatter everything at once.
- [Leap Year Test](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/leapyear/): Submit a year to the Leap Certification Bureau and get a stamped verdict
- [Metronome](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/metronome/): A big honest metronome. Tap the tempo, it keeps it.
- [Names in a Hat](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/namesinahat/): Put names in the hat. Tap the hat. The hat decides.
- [Paint by Number](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/paint-by-number/): Upload a photo, get a numbered kit, and paint it back together. Drag to paint; stay true to the original.
- [Password Generator](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/passwordgenerator/): A mint that strikes passwords one character tile at a time
- [Picsum Photo Generator](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/randomphotos/): Endless stock photos pinned like polaroids — click one to copy its URL
- [Random Color](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/randomcolor/): A random color with its hex, rgb, and hsl — click for another
- [Ruler](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/ruler/): A real ruler on your screen — calibrate it with a credit card
- [Scoreboard](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/scoreboard/): A tap-to-score scoreboard for any game — track two teams, period, and time
- [Swiss Army Knife](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/swissarmyknife/): A pocket knife for images — fold out the crop blade, the filter glass, the resize scissors. Everything happens on your device.
- [Time Meters](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/timemeters/): Progress bars for the day, week, month, year, decade, century, and millennium
- [Timezone Ticket](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/timezones/): A live boarding pass between any two time zones. Gate B7, as always.
- [What's My Resolution?](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/whatsmyresolution/): Your screen, measured live — resolution, pixel ratio, refresh rate, and every pixel you own
- [Your Birthday, Your Color!](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/birthdaycolor/): Enter your birthday and get your unique hex color

## Games

- [3D Snake](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/snake/): Play a 3D version of the classic snake game with improved graphics and physics
- [Balance the Stick](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/balancethestick/): A stick, a cart, and your one job: keep it upright. The wind disagrees.
- [Binary Sudoku](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/binary-sudoku/): Sudoku with only 0s and 1s. The hardest mode is a 2×2 grid. You will win.
- [Board Game Generator](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/board-game-generator/): Generate unique Mario Party-style boards with forks, teleporters, traps, and chaos spaces
- [Clap-o-Meter](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/clap-o-meter/): Ten seconds. Clap anywhere, as fast as you can. Ring the bell and the meter will remember.
- [Colorle](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/colorle/): One color a day, six tries to mix it. The department rounds generously.
- [Copter](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/copter/): Hold to fly, release to fall. Thread your little helicopter through a narrowing cave for as long as you can. One button, endlessly hard.
- [Count a Second](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/countasecond/): Count the seconds in your head. Find out how wrong your internal clock is.
- [Country Marble Race](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/marble-race/): Flag marbles, six neon gauntlets, one country eliminated per round. Place your loyalties.
- [Fair Die](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/fairdie/): A certified fair die. The calibration panel is for maintenance purposes only.
- [Font Ninja](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/fontninja/): Words fly. Slice only the target font. Wrong typeface costs a shuriken.
- [How Many?](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/howmany/): Dots flash for half a second — how many were there?
- [Infinite Tic Tac Toe](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/infinitetictactoe/): Tic tac toe on a board that does not end. Five in a row. The computer is patient.
- [Largest Number Game](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/largestnumber/): Try to enter the largest number possible
- [Perfect Circle](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/perfectcircle/): Draw a circle freehand. Get judged to one decimal place.
- [Pong](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/pong/): Classic Pong
- [Powder Toy](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/fallingsand/): A falling-sand sandbox. Pour sand, water, and oil, strike a match, and watch it all react. Fire spreads, plants drink, oil floats. No goal, just physics.
- [Prop Hunt](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/emojiprophunt/): One of them is wanted. Find the exact match — the decoys are in on it.
- [Race Your Ghost](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/typingrace/): Type the line before your own ghost does. It never gets nervous and it never forgets your best time.
- [Reaction Time](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/reactiontime/): Click when the screen turns green. How fast are you?
- [Red Light, Green Light](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/redlightgreenlight/): Hold to walk, freeze on red. Momentum is not your friend, and the official is watching.
- [Scratchers](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/scratchers/): An endless supply of scratch-off tickets. The $1 ticket is always free. The rest is between you and the odds.
- [Shape Match](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/shapematch/): Same shape or mirrored? Decide fast. One mistake ends it. No appeals.
- [Shortwave](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/shortwave/): Tune a late-night radio through the static. 72 stations are hiding out there — some only broadcast after dark.
- [Simon](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/simon/): Watch the pattern, then repeat it back. Each round adds one more light and a little more speed. How long can you hold the sequence in your head?
- [Spin the Bottle](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/spinthebottle/): Add your friends around the table, rip the bottle, and let it decide.
- [The Restoration](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/puzzle/): The museum's daily painting arrived in pieces. Slide it back together.
- [Virtual Piano](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/piano/): Play music on a virtual piano keyboard
- [Winter Bells](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/bouncehigher/): Steer a snow bunny up an endless winter sky. Every bell you touch bounces you higher — chain them for combos and climb as high as you can before you fall.

## Entertainment

- [89 Degree Triangle](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/triangle/): A triangle with an 89 degree angle. Extend the edge and watch one degree ruin everything.
- [Brain Rot Engine](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/brainrotengine/): Configure your rot — how many balls, whether they multiply — then let it run.
- [Chicanery](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/chicanery/): I AM NOT CRAZY!
- [Christmas Eve Eve Eve...](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/christmaseve/): HOW MANY DAYS UNTIL CHRISTMAS AHHH
- [Confession](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/confession/): Type something anonymously. It disappears. No one reads it. Maybe that's the point.
- [Do You Like Me?](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/do-you-like-me/): A fun interactive yes/no question with a twist
- [Doomscroll](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/doomscroll/): An infinite feed of increasingly absurd headlines. You can't stop scrolling.
- [Drips](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/drips/): A quiet pool of real water. Drag a finger through it.
- [DVD Bounce](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/dvd/): Watch the DVD logo bounce around the screen
- [Grow Your Garden](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/growyourgarden/): Click to plant seeds that grow in real time. Come back tomorrow and they're taller.
- [Hatch The Egg](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/hatchtheegg/): Wait and watch the egg hatch!
- [How Long Have You Been Staring?](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/howlonghaveyoubeenstaring/): A timer. That's it. Just a timer counting how long you've been here.
- [I'm Sorry :(](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/im-sorry/): A way to "sincerely" apologize to anyone you have wronged
- [Infinite Loader](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/infinite-loader/): A loading bar headed for 100%. It will not arrive. Click to hurry it — that has been noted.
- [Interdimensional DVR](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/interdimensionaldvr/): Watch interdimensional cable shows from across the multiverse
- [Lyrics to Songs Without Lyrics](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/lyrics/): Karaoke for instrumentals. Follow the bouncing ball through every word there isn't.
- [Meme Soundboard](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/meme-soundboard/): Play classic meme sound effects and download them
- [Oddly Specific Horoscopes](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/horoscope/): The stars have reviewed your file. Today's reading is uncomfortably precise.
- [On Hold](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/onhold/): Your call is important to us. Please continue to hold.
- [Severance Dance](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/severancedance/): Watch the MDR Department dance to your favorite tunes
- [Shakespeare Insult Maker](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/shakespeareinsultmaker/): Generate Shakespearean-style insults
- [Static](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/static/): TV static that slowly resolves into a hidden message. Wait for it.
- [The Last Survivors](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/thelastsurvivors/): Conway's Game of Life with colored tribes. Place cells, place your bet, watch the chaos.
- [The Last Time](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/the-last-time/): A quiet scroll through the moments that passed without a goodbye
- [The Magic Number 4](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/magicnumber/): A fun interactive way to learn about the number 4
- [The Map](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/themap/): A procedurally generated fantasy map. Different every time.
- [Translate to Legalese](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/translatetolegalese/): Type anything casual. Get back an incomprehensible legal document.
- [Unmotivational Quotes](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/unmotivationalquotes/): Your daily dose of disappointment
- [What to do](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/what-to-do/): Helps you figure out your priorities for the day...
- [WOW](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/wow/): Endless wows. Click for more wow. Hold to spray wow.
- [Your Phone Has a Crack in It](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/yourphonehasacrackinit/): Your phone has a crack in it. Tap the screen and it will have several.

## Mindfulness

- [Breathe](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/breathe/): A circle that breathes. Match it — box, 4-7-8, or resonant pace
- [Daily Affirmations](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/affirmations/): Take a number at the municipal office of morale — affirmations, notarized
- [Noise Machine](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/noise-machine/): Mix white, brown, and pink noise with rain, thunder, café chatter, and fan hum — all generated live in your browser.
- [Sand Garden](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/sandgarden/): Drag to rake grooves into a patch of sand, tap to set a stone. It waits exactly as you left it, the next time you visit.
- [Worry Jar](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/worryjar/): Write down what's weighing on you and drop it in the jar. Watch it sink, settle, and take up permanent residence.
- [Wreck Room](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/wreckroom/): Upload a picture of your problem. Take a bat to it.
- [Yin Yang](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/yinyang/): Click it. It spins, and says which one it is now.

## Art

- [Anaglyph](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/anaglyph/): A field of shapes rendered in true color-split 3D. Drag sideways for red/cyan, up and down for green/magenta. Glasses recommended, not provided.
- [ASCII Earth](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/asciiearth/): The whole planet, rendered live in twelve characters. Drag to spin it, let go and it keeps turning — night side and all.
- [Chess Art Generator](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/chess-art/): Six chess pieces wander an infinite board, only ever making legal moves, leaving colored trails behind them. Tap to drop your own.
- [Chromatic](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/chromatic/): Drag to paint. Red, green, and blue each chase your cursor at their own speed, splitting into a glitchy fringe and re-fusing to white when you hold still.
- [Color Collage](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/colorcollage/): A giant grid of color, edge to edge. Click anywhere and the whole grid ripples into that color's neighborhood.
- [Dot Field](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/dotfield/): A grid of dots that grows and glows wherever you hover, then slowly settles back down.
- [Fireflies](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/fireflies/): A meadow of fireflies slowly finds one shared rhythm. Click to scatter it.
- [Gravity Well](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/gravitywell/): A drifting field of particles. Your cursor is a gravity well — pull them into orbit, or slingshot them across the screen.
- [Groundhog](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/groundhog/): Every round wipes the canvas, rebuilds everything you've drawn so far in its original colors, then hands you a fresh color to add on top.
- [Heat Trail](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/heattrail/): Move around and the room remembers, in heat. Hold still and it gets hotter.
- [Infinite Gradient](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/infinite-gradient/): An endless grid of generated gradient tiles — linear, radial, conic, striped. Drag to explore, scroll to zoom, tap any tile to copy its CSS.
- [Ink Drop](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/inkdrop/): Click to drop ink into water and watch it bloom, curl, and mix
- [Kaleidoscope](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/kaleidoscope/): Paint with radial symmetry — every stroke blooms into a mandala
- [Lenticular](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/lenticular/): Two scenes, sliced into fine plastic ridges. Move your cursor (or tilt your phone) side to side and watch one comb into the other.
- [Library of Everything](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/library-of-everything/): View the vast endlessness of numbers
- [Life Of Color Theory](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/colortheory/): Every day, a new color from the RGB spectrum is displayed in a 45,964-year journey
- [Moiré](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/moire/): Two fine grids of lines, slightly out of tune. Drag to turn one, scroll or pinch to change the beat.
- [Murmuration](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/murmuration/): A few thousand starlings at dusk. Your cursor is the hawk.
- [Museum of Bad Art](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/bad-art-museum/): Procedurally generated terrible abstract paintings paired with pompous gallery descriptions. Infinite collection.
- [One Pixel](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/onepixel/): The smallest painting on the web. One pixel, one color. A new one tomorrow.
- [Parallax](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/parallax/): A field of sticker shapes stacked in depth. Move your cursor, tilt your phone, and watch the near ones race past the far ones.
- [Parallel Lines](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/parallel_lines/): Two rails run straight toward a vanishing point, forever. They look like they're about to meet. They never do.
- [Ransom Note](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/ransomnote/): A wall of plain words. Sweep across them and each one is cut loose — new font, new color, pinned back crooked, like a ransom note assembling itself.
- [Rothko Machine](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/rothkomachine/): An endless stream of generated color field paintings, each with a deadpan title
- [Silk](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/silk/): Move your cursor and watch silky ribbons of color flow and mirror around the screen. No instructions, no UI — just trace.
- [Spirograph](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/spirograph/): A gear rolls inside a ring and traces the flower it was always going to make. Drag to scrub the mechanism, switch gears to layer another.
- [String Art](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/stringart/): Sweep your cursor around the ring of pins and thread stretches between them, leaving a permanent, ever-growing pattern behind.
- [Tessellation](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/tessellation/): Draw anywhere and your strokes tile into an endless repeating pattern
- [The Ellipsis](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/ellipsis/): The whole page is a dot. Click it and another one shows up. That's all this is.
- [The Infinite Painting](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/infinitepainting/): Zoom into the brushstrokes. There is no bottom.
- [Tile](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/tile/): A random geometric tile that repeats out to the edges of forever. Drag to wander it, tap for a new one.
- [Tilt](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/tilt/): A scattered deck of cards, each tilting toward your cursor in real 3D and catching a moving glare across its face.
- [Weaver](https://randomsitesontheweb.com/weaver/): Drag to lay threads on a loom — warp and weft interlace into real cloth
